register_mephisto_abstraction: register a new Blueprint, Architect, or CrowdProvider class using the register_mephisto_abstraction decorator
fill_registries: dynamically import and register all CrowdProviders, Architects, and Blueprints from the mephisto abstractions directories
get_crowd_provider_from_type: look up and return the CrowdProvider class by its registered provider type string name
get_blueprint_from_type: look up and return the Blueprint class by its registered task type string name
get_valid_provider_types: list all currently registered and supported crowd provider type names in the mephisto framework
